implementationConstraints: Generic reviewed sequence metadata with localized advance/display text and ordered route-anchored checkpoints.
Original routing and raw maneuvers remain unchanged; v2-capable apps explicitly request sequence metadata by HTTP header. Legacy clients keep ordinary guidance for these five movements.

Checkpoint speech requires <=15m GPS accuracy, confirmed recent movement and an approaching heading. The first Entry-4 outbound checkpoint can select straight only when actual motion aligns with its outgoing direction. At the corner stale direction is rejected.
Ordinary internal maneuvers and rerouting remain suppressed inside the approved area. Only the reviewed checkpoint instructions may speak. No time-based TTS sequence or late catch-up.
Wilram to Exit-2 stays a legal standard right turn outside the polygon.
Both languages, walking controls, repeated visits, malformed metadata, resets, wrong direction and poor GPS are covered by regression tests. Field test still pending.
alternativeCrossingVerification: Direction-dependent straight/right selection implemented and checked with synthetic actual GPS fixes. Physical alternative crossing has not yet been field-tested.
